fields.subject: ArgentSeaReminderOptionsValidator
fields.condition: ReminderOptions.MinimumReminderPeriod is not less than TimeSpan.Zero
fields.trigger: ValidateConfiguration is called and MinimumReminderPeriod.TotalMinutes is less than ReminderOptionsDefaults.MinimumReminderPeriodMinutes
fields.response: complete validation without throwing and invoke ILogger.LogWarning under RSErrorCode.RS_FastReminderInterval reporting the configured period against the default minimum
fields.postcondition: an unusually short reminder period does not fail validation; ValidateConfiguration invokes ILogger.LogWarning under RS_FastReminderInterval reporting the configured period against the default minimum, rather than rejecting the period outright or returning with no logging call

sources.label: The negative-period guard (31-36) that would otherwise throw, the below-floor warning if-block, and the method's control reaching its end (line 43) without a throw
